name: Maven Tests

on:
  push:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'
      
	  - name: Run Maven Tests
        run: mvn test
